scientific_scope: Gaussian short-time Fourier localization, two equal disjoint planar disks of fixed area R>0, center distance d tending to infinity; two largest eigenvalues and their normalized eigenmodes.
title: Coherent-state tunneling and the sharp top spectral doublet of two distant Gaussian localization disks
